logline: Cornered and chained in the damp dungeon, Juliana shatters Catherine's cruelty with unshakeable dignity and the truth about love and worth, driving Catherine into a murderous fury.
continuity_notes: Picks up immediately from Episode 31's cliffhanger where Catherine used a glowing branding iron to scorch Juliana's mother's herbal book.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on the open botanical ledger lying on the wet stone floor as the glowing red branding tip sizzles against the delicate parchment.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Sizzling, crackling sound of scorched parchment paper.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana, chained against the brick wall, tears glistening on her cheeks as she trembles in grief.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Mocking, Savoring)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: There it is.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle medium shot of Catherine in her opulent velvet gown, clutching the hot poker with a sadistic sneer.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Whispering, Venomous)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Fear.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine leaning slightly forward over the burning book, eyes glittering with malice.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Taunting)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: You have been so proud of that brave little face...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot showing Juliana chained against the cold dungeon wall, small and restrained beneath Catherine's towering shadow.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Smug, Dominant)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: ...but now you are afraid.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Catherine straightening up haughtily.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana, her lips trembling in agonizing sorrow.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Cruel, Final)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Say goodbye to your mother.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot of Catherine swinging the flaming orange iron upward from the book.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana's despair suddenly solidifies. Her jaw tightens, tears stopping as resolve takes over.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana looking up directly at Catherine, fear replaced by cold conviction.

segments.label: JULIANA (Defiant, Unbroken)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Burn it.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Juliana, sitting upright despite her heavy iron shackles.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine, her smug expression abruptly flickering with startled confusion.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Disconcerted)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: What?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle close-up of Juliana staring straight up into Catherine's eyes without flinching.

segments.label: JULIANA (Firm, Resolute)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Burn the ledger. Burn every page.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot of the wet dungeon floor, guards stationed by the heavy iron doorway in the background as Catherine holds the hot brand.

segments.label: JULIANA (Steely, Proud)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: You may destroy the book...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine's face darkening with irritation.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium low-angle shot of Juliana sitting amidst chains beneath the barred ceiling grate.

segments.label: JULIANA (Transcendent, Defiant)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: ...you cannot destroy what my mother taught me.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine leaning down aggressively into Juliana's space, trembling with offended rage.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Spiteful, Hissing)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: You think a few herbs make you better than me?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana looking steadily up into Catherine's furious glare.

segments.label: JULIANA (Calm, Cutting)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: No. Your cruelty does that for me.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: High-angle over-the-shoulder shot looking down at Juliana bound in heavy chains on the damp floor.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of Catherine, baring her teeth in outrage.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Furious, Shouting)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: You still think you are better?!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana, her chained hands clasped together in her lap.

segments.label: JULIANA (Serene, Grounded)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I know what I am.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Catherine scoffing with forced, derisive laughter.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Sneering, Mocking)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: A disgraced woman?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana speaking with undeniable strength.

segments.label: JULIANA (Unwavering)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: A woman who survived. You cannot destroy me.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine brandishing the glowing tong in Juliana's face, spittle flying from her lips.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Screaming, Enraged)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: You are lying!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana looking straight up, voice steady and clear.

segments.label: JULIANA (Measured, Emphatic)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Gerald leaving me was the best thing he ever did for me.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Full shot of the dungeon cell. Catherine stands rigidly tall while Juliana sits shackled on the ground.

segments.label: JULIANA (Contemplative, Scathing)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: He wanted a woman who looked beautiful beside his wealth.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana's expressive blue eyes and tear-stained cheek.

segments.label: JULIANA (Passionate, Clear)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: He wanted a wife whose family could raise his name. He measured a woman's worth by what she could give him.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot of Juliana leaning slightly forward against her chains.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine staring down, her eyes widening as Juliana's words pierce her facade.

segments.label: JULIANA (Unapologetic, Victorious)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Let him have Clarissa.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana smiling with genuine liberation.

segments.label: JULIANA (Proud)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: He lost me.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of Catherine's face contorting in sheer fury.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Shrieking, Vicious)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: You were rejected!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana's calm, resolute face.

segments.label: JULIANA (Grounded, Powerful)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I was freed. And I found a man who never asked me what I was worth.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot of the cell, steam rising faintly in the cold subterranean air.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine sneering with dripping condescension.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Disdainful)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Your soldier?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glowing with genuine devotion.

segments.label: JULIANA (Tender, Certain)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: My husband.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine scowling with deep disgust.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Bitter)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: He is a nobody.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana smiling softly, totally untroubled.

segments.label: JULIANA (Warm, Defiant)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Then I love a nobody.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot focusing on Juliana's bare, chained feet locked in iron on the stone floor.

segments.label: JULIANA (Resonant, Moving)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Because that nobody showed me more love than your entire world ever did.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Catherine gripping the branding rod tighter, her upper lip curling in fury.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Indignant, Sharp)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: You know nothing about my world.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana sitting in her tattered apron and chains, looking composed.

segments.label: JULIANA (Knowing, Sober)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I know exactly what your world values.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana's lips and eyes as she lists them with chilling precision.

segments.label: JULIANA (Listing, Deliberate)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Beauty. Money.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of Catherine's wide, stunned eyes reacting to the naked truth.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana looking up unflinchingly.

segments.label: JULIANA (Firm)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Family. A perfect name.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot of Catherine standing rigid in her gold and purple gown, the guard standing sentinel behind her.

segments.label: JULIANA (Continuing)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: And a woman who never embarrasses the people standing behind her.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine throwing her hands up in explosive defensiveness.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Shouting, Outraged)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: And what is wrong with that?!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine's face twisting in absolute venom.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana looking serene.

segments.label: JULIANA (Gentle, Penetrating)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Nothing. Until you have nothing left beneath it.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Catherine standing motionless, holding the iron rod, struck to the core by the insult.

segments.label: JULIANA (Unrelenting)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: You have spent your whole life collecting things that make people bow...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot of Juliana's chained hands folded peacefully in her lap.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Juliana looking up with quiet pity.

segments.label: JULIANA (Piercing)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: ...but you have never learned how to make anyone love you.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Catherine snapping entirely, raising the branding poker like a weapon and screaming.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Hysterical, Screaming)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Silence! Silence!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine's crazed, gasping face.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Shrieking)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Why?!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana crying out her defiance.

segments.label: JULIANA (Forceful)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Because I am right!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle tracking shot of the red-hot branding tip trailing across the wet dungeon floor, steaming.

segments.label: JULIANA (Scathing, Direct)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: You want everyone to believe you are powerful.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana sitting under the cold skylight bars, her posture majestic despite her imprisonment.

segments.label: JULIANA (Continuing)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: You want everyone to fear you.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana looking directly at Catherine, gestures restrained by the heavy iron chains.

segments.label: JULIANA (Mocking, Direct)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: But look at you.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes burning with fiery contempt.

segments.label: JULIANA (Stripping Her Bare)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: You have to threaten a chained woman to feel powerful!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine trembling with uncontrollable rage, teeth bared.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Choking with Rage)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: You insolent—!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Catherine gripping the glowing tongs as Juliana continues speaking over her.

segments.label: JULIANA (Steely, Triumphant)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: You may have the title you have always wanted...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana delivering the final emotional blow.

segments.label: JULIANA (Final, Condemning)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: ...but you will never have the courage to earn what you demand from everyone else.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine's face twitching with sheer murderous madness.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Enraged, Shouting)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: You think you can lecture me?!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Catherine raising the branding iron high above her head with both hands.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Catherine hoists the searing branding rod over Juliana with frantic fury.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Screaming, Maniacal)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Then let's see how brave you are when it touches your skin!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Catherine plunging the glowing orange poker straight toward Juliana's face.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana gasps, freezing as the glowing tip of the iron thrusts forward, stopping mere millimeters from her right eye.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana's wide, unblinking blue eye. The intense, fiery orange glow of the iron poker radiates inches from her cornea, holding on the heart-stopping cliffhanger as the frame cuts to black.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Hysterical, Screaming)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Silence! Silence!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine's crazed, gasping face.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Shrieking)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Why?!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana crying out her defiance.

segments.label: JULIANA (Forceful)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Because I am right!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle tracking shot of the red-hot branding tip trailing across the wet dungeon floor, steaming.

segments.label: JULIANA (Scathing, Direct)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: You want everyone to believe you are powerful.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana sitting under the cold skylight bars, her posture majestic despite her imprisonment.

segments.label: JULIANA (Continuing)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: You want everyone to fear you.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana looking directly at Catherine, gestures restrained by the heavy iron chains.

segments.label: JULIANA (Mocking, Direct)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: But look at you.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes burning with fiery contempt.

segments.label: JULIANA (Stripping Her Bare)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: You have to threaten a chained woman to feel powerful!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine trembling with uncontrollable rage, teeth bared.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Choking with Rage)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: You insolent—!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Catherine gripping the glowing tongs as Juliana continues speaking over her.

segments.label: JULIANA (Steely, Triumphant)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: You may have the title you have always wanted...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana delivering the final emotional blow.

segments.label: JULIANA (Final, Condemning)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: ...but you will never have the courage to earn what you demand from everyone else.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine's face twitching with sheer murderous madness.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Enraged, Shouting)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: You think you can lecture me?!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Catherine raising the branding iron high above her head with both hands.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Catherine hoists the searing branding rod over Juliana with frantic fury.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Screaming, Maniacal)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Then let's see how brave you are when it touches your skin!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Catherine plunging the glowing orange poker straight toward Juliana's face.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana gasps, freezing as the glowing tip of the iron thrusts forward, stopping mere millimeters from her right eye.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana's wide, unblinking blue eye. The intense, fiery orange glow of the iron poker radiates inches from her cornea, holding on the heart-stopping cliffhanger as the frame cuts to black.
